focus: Angle 13 — preamble and leaf-set policy contradictions

findingDetails.title: Fleet documents two mutually exclusive always-loaded-preamble policies and the compiled runtime enforces neither
findingDetails.evidence: system-deep-loop hub-router.json:13 and cli-external-orchestration hub-router.json:21-24 declare defaultResource arrays while their ROUTER.md blocks say no always-loaded preamble with DEFAULT_RESOURCE=[] (ROUTER.md:67-69, :85-87); sk-code pairs hub-router:14 [shared/README.md] against ROUTER.md:319-325's three-file preamble and sk-code-opencode/SKILL.md:60-66's five-file one. compiler.cjs:184-185 admits only a scalar; the bound runtime compiler 001 never reads the field, 004 nulls it (:235), 007 truncates to [0] (:313). Live snapshot loads for all three hubs show policy keys with no defaultResource, executed decisions carry no preamble, and DEFAULT_RESOURCE has zero hits in the compiled-routing tree.
findingDetails.impact: A reader cannot tell which preamble policy runs because no code path runs either; the two authored statements contradict at the layer that would have to resolve them.
findingDetails.recommendation: Keep one statement per hub in a form a consumer can read, delete the other, and remove or redefine the hub-router array. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read all three policy blocks and machine blocks at their lines, traced the field through five compilers and the runtime layout selector, executed the route front door for three hubs, and loaded the exact policy snapshots the engine evaluates to prove the field is absent.

findingDetails.title: Improvement lanes receive byte-identical 61-leaf sets against the generator's N-to-1 distinctness contract and no consumer needs the distinction
findingDetails.evidence: agent-improvement and model-benchmark arrays compare equal (61 leaves each) while both declare packet deep-improvement with distinct loopHostMode and aliases; generate-leaf-manifest.cjs:155-158 promises N-to-1 alias fan-out keeps distinct independently addressable sets; DUPLICATE_COMPOSITE only guards within one mode; no leaf-aliases.json exists; the compiled pipeline validates per-mode RESOURCE_MAP membership only (002/registry-compiler.cjs:464-511), so identical supersets pass.
findingDetails.impact: Manifest semantics are blurred for any future leaf-driven consumer and the generator's stated guarantee is unmet; no live route breaks today.
findingDetails.recommendation: Either implement the alias-file mechanism for the deep-improvement lanes or amend the generator contract to state that co-located modes share a leaf set by design. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Re-verified byte equality programmatically, read the registry entries and the generator contract, checked for an alias file, and read the compiled pipeline's membership-only validation before concluding the impact is bounded.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: A fleet-wide enforcement question answered by executing the runtime front door and loading the live policy snapshots for three hubs, plus a five-compiler trace and an N-to-1 manifest identity check.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Angle 13 names two questions — which preamble policy the runtime enforces, and whether identical leaf sets are defect or design; the enforcement answer lives in the compiler chain and the live engine, and the identity answer lives in the manifest, registry and generator contract.

searchLedger.invariant: Two artifacts describing the same hub policy must state it the same way.

searchActions.queryOrPath: routerPolicy.defaultResource vs ROUTER.md DEFAULT_RESOURCE blocks for all three hubs
searchActions.result: Two hubs state opposite existence; the third states different content and cardinality; the schema admits only a scalar.

searchLedger.rationale: The contradiction is fleet-wide, not hub-local, and the field shape is out of its own contract.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The compiled router loads the declared preamble before mode selection.

searchActions.queryOrPath: live loadSnapshot() policy for the three hubs, plus compiled-route.cjs executions
searchActions.result: No defaultResource key in any policy; no preamble field in any decision; DEFAULT_RESOURCE absent from the entire compiled-routing tree.

searchLedger.rationale: The enforcement answer is 'none'; the statements describe a behavior no code performs.

searchLedger.invariant: An N-to-1 alias fan-out keeps independently addressable leaf sets.

searchActions.queryOrPath: byte equality of the two improvement-lane arrays, alias-file presence, compiled-pipeline validation of manifest resources
searchActions.result: Arrays equal at 61; no alias file; pipeline enforces per-mode membership only, so identity passes.

searchLedger.rationale: The stated guarantee is unmet but no consumer depends on it, which bounds severity.
